title: Single Zero: My roulette roguelite
author: olafthemanofsnow
selftext:
Hey everyone,

So i have been working on my own take of a roulette roguelite for a few months now and am excited to share my latest teaser of the game.

The game replaces a traditional card deck builder by replacing the cards with a roulette wheel.

It has been something I have wanted to build for ages and something I had been designing months before I even started using claude. 

You can try out the latest demo of the game here

:

https://single-zero.vercel.app/

I would really welcome feedback if you have the time. Its still a long way from being finished but its been a fun project.
